**Earliest purchase time in Maine (the state that contains the Tracy‑Causer Block in Portland): 5 a.m.**

- The Maine Revised Statutes, **Title 28‑A, § 4 (a)(1)** (Business days and hours) state that *“Licensees may sell or deliver liquor from 5 a.m. on any day until 1 a.m. of the following day.”*  
- This applies to all licensed retailers—including grocery stores, supermarkets, convenience stores, and private liquor markets—across the entire state of Maine.  
- The only day with an earlier start is **New Year’s Day**: § 4 (b) allows sales from **12 a.m. (midnight) to 2 a.m.** 

Thus, under normal circumstances, you can first purchase alcohol in Maine at **5 a.m.** on any day of the week.
